name: Zero-G MMO
storyline:
The year is 2264. After a century of climate crises and global pandemics, humanity has finally turned its gaze toward the stars, not as a dream, but as a survival necessity. Zero-G is a persistent, single-shard Space MMO that simulates the inner Solar System using 1:1 NASA topographic data and uncompromising Newtonian physics. There are no "space-brakes" here, only momentum, mass, and the cold reality of the vacuum.

The era of simple exploration is over. Under the guidance of the Vatican Academy, humanity has established a permanent presence across the Moon, Mars, and Venus. But as the first private Ventures begin to claim terrestrial quadrants and build trade depots, a new shadow has fallen over the system.
An aggressive Alien Incursion has begun. Utilizing a terrifying "Jump Drive" technology that defies our understanding of Newtonian flight, these fleets have struck the first blow near Mars, leading to the first persistent player casualties in history.
You are a pilot in this unfolding conflict. Starting from the Grottaglie Spaceport, you must master the "Flip & Burn" mechanics of realistic space flight to navigate the 1:1 scale of our Solar System.
...
Now, humanity has discovered something strange: the Asteroid Belt, the one region the aliens refuse to enter. Whether out of fear or ancient knowledge, no one knows. But where the enemy will not follow, human pilots have gone straight in — mining the rocks for the rare compounds needed to rebuild the fleet, and searching for whatever it is the aliens are so careful to avoid.
summary: A persistent browser MMO set in a 1:1 scale solar system built on real NASA MOLA/LOLA altimetry data, with real orbital physics. Explore the planets, mine asteroids in real-time skill-based instances, refine and craft using a periodic-table economy, trade in a player-driven market, and fight aliens in a fully cooperative universe where nothing ever resets. Free to play, no download — runs in any browser, including mobile.
